prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a polished architectural concept sheet for an expansion to this exact Halo Forerunner multiplayer map. Both supplied screenshots are references to the SAME existing map: image 1 red-base side, image 2 mirrored blue-base side. Remove all HUD, weapons, annotations, red boxes, text overlays. THREE PANELS: upper left an exterior paintover matching image 1's camera, upper right exterior matching image 2's camera, lower wide panel an eye-level view INSIDE the proposed connecting hallway. Preserve the existing tall wall, upper balcony and railings, base buildings, coastal cliffs, terrain, approximate scale and daylight. Change only the lower cliff-filled zone directly beneath the balcony: excavate it and insert a broad, deeply recessed, chamfered Forerunner facility entrance on EACH team side, geometrically mirrored. Entrance fits UNDER the existing balcony slab, approximately 6 metres wide and 3.5 metres clear height, 2.1m Spartan scale. Retain structural supports outside openings. Subtle team red/blue identification near corresponding entrance, otherwise cyan-white recessed lighting. Open entrance reveals a legible lit vestibule and corridor turning sideways parallel to the wall, connecting both entrances; no endless straight sniper tunnel. Exterior portals have layered angled metallic reveals, bronze-grey concrete-metal masses, dark gunmetal recesses, precisely aligned beveled edges, restrained segmented cyan light strips, modest engraved angular seams, practical wide flat thresholds flush to terrain, uncluttered combat sightlines. Remove obstructing rocks just at entrances and move the Warthog clear of the new opening. Interior panel: usable broad Halo CE-inspired Forerunner hallway carved behind the cliff, low monumental ribbed ceiling, chamfered structural bays, layered dark wall panels, clean grey floor with subtle angular seams and illuminated edges, dogleg junction visible, a pool of daylight through a distant entrance. Large sealed symmetrical blast doors in shallow side recesses, dim amber lock indicators, no handles or access prompts: these suggest inaccessible deeper facility. Central traversal route visually OPEN, sealed doors visually solid. A small helmeted armored Spartan near one rib only for scale. Natural material variation, good shadow detail, no glossy white sterile corridors, no excessive greebles, no curved architecture, no staircases blocking the opening, no new towers, no alteration to upper balcony silhouette. Render credible game-ready geometry, closely matching current map's architectural language, with improved material hierarchy and warm/cool light contrast. Minimal clean panel captions: RED ENTRANCE, BLUE ENTRANCE, CONNECTING HALL. This is a proposed concept, not an actual built-game screenshot.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this architectural concept sheet with ONE targeted change: in both UPPER exterior panels, replace the visible straight-through tunnel and distant daylight at the back of each entrance with a shallow enclosed facility vestibule that turns sideways along the wall. Keep the broad outer entrance completely OPEN and inviting. About 5 metres behind each threshold, a solid articulated dark Forerunner wall with a sealed inset maintenance door, small amber lock lights, and modest chamfered details stops the direct line of sight. A clearly open, generously wide and visibly lit lateral passage branches to the viewer's RIGHT inside the RED ENTRANCE vestibule, and to the viewer's LEFT inside the BLUE ENTRANCE vestibule, leading along the great wall beneath the balcony and connecting the two team sides. Show these side passages through the exterior openings by suitable interior lighting and bevel geometry without moving cameras. This must read as a substantial interior facility, not an outdoor underpass or a closed entrance. Match these mirrored vestibules exactly in scale and structural design. Preserve everything else: all exterior geometry above balcony, bases, grass, cliffs, camera framing, the three-panel sheet composition and captions. Preserve the LOWER CONNECTING HALL panel's architectural design and central sightline-breaking pier, spacious passage, Spartan scale reference, sealed amber-lit side doors, dark metal grey floor, and restrained cyan lighting. No extra towers, no exterior stairs, no HUD, no annotations, no new text. Buildable Halo CE-inspired Forerunner architecture. This remains concept art, not a screenshot of built changes.

design_intent.entrances: Mirrored openings beneath existing balcony, approximately 6m wide x 3.5m clear; fit dimensions to measured Blender geometry before implementation.
design_intent.route: Red vestibule -> lateral corridor -> central sightline-breaking junction -> mirrored blue vestibule. Maintain equal travel distance and cover.
design_intent.doors: Sealed decorative doors imply deeper facility; solid collision, amber lock accents, no interaction prompts.
design_intent.materials: Existing eight surface roles, grey-bronze structure, dark recesses, restrained cyan lights and team-colored entrance accents.
design_intent.next_validation: Check player/camera scale, PCG exclusions, terrain and cliff removal, roof support and route clearance in Blender before game bake.
